lines.en: How did Roy stop the thieves?
lines.zh: 罗伊是怎样制止小偷的？

lines.en: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
lines.zh: 罗伊·特伦顿以前是开出租车的。

lines.en: A short while ago, however,
lines.zh: 然而，不久前，

lines.en: he became a bus driver
lines.zh: 他当上了一名公共汽车司机，

lines.en: and he has not regretted it.
lines.zh: 他一点也不后悔。

lines.en: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
lines.zh: 他觉得自己的新工作更加激动人心。

lines.en: When he was driving
lines.zh: 最近，当他开着车

lines.en: along Catford Street recently,
lines.zh: 沿卡特福德大街行驶时，

lines.en: he saw two thieves rush out of a shop
lines.zh: 他看见两个小偷从一家商店里冲出来，

lines.en: and run towards a waiting car.
lines.zh: 朝一辆等在那里的汽车跑去。

lines.en: One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
lines.zh: 其中一个提着一满袋钱。

lines.en: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus
lines.zh: 罗伊迅速行动，

lines.en: straight at the thieves.
lines.zh: 把公共汽车径直朝小偷开去。

lines.en: The one with the money got such a fright
lines.zh: 拿钱的那个小偷吓了一大跳，

lines.en: that he dropped the bag.
lines.zh: 把袋子都弄掉了。

lines.en: As the thieves were trying to get away in their car,
lines.zh: 当小偷们试图乘车逃跑时，

lines.en: Roy drove his bus into the back of it.
lines.zh: 罗伊开着公共汽车撞在小偷汽车的尾部。

lines.en: While the battered car was moving away,
lines.zh: 就在那辆被撞坏的汽车开走的时候，

lines.en: Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
lines.zh: 罗伊停下公共汽车给警察打了电话。

lines.en: The thieves' car was badly damaged and easy to recognize.
lines.zh: 小偷的汽车已严重受损，很容易辨认。

lines.en: Shortly afterwards,
lines.zh: 不久，

lines.en: the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
lines.zh: 警察截住了那辆汽车，两名男子都被捕了。
